description: Αρχείο βεβαιωμένων παραβάσεων Κώδικα Οδικής Κυκλοφορίας από τη Δημοτική Αστυνομία του Δήμου Θεσσαλονίκης is a dataset listed in data.gov.gr, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Διεύθυνση Δημοτικής Αστυνομίας. Registo de violações do Código da Estrada, confirmado pela Polícia Municipal do Município de Salónica. Coverage: Διεύθυνση Δημοτικής Αστυνομίας. The portal shows the English title as "Salonikų savivaldybės policijos patvirtintų kelių eismo taisyklių pažeidimų registras" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Διεύθυνση Δημοτικής Αστυνομίας. Its keywords include Παραβάσεισ κ.ο.κ., Κ.ο.κ., repository.data.gov.gr, Δημοτική αστυνομία, Κώδικασ οδικήσ κυκλοφορίασ, Από μετάπτωση. The listing shows 4 download or service links in CSV, XLS. The listing shows 2026-02-22 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-data-gov-gr.
